projects.title: Automate Animation (Lip-sync)
projects.shortDescription: Innovative mouth lipsyncing tool website that automates 2D animation creation
projects.detailedDescription: Developed and implemented an innovative mouth lipsyncing tool website that automates the process of creating 2D mouth lipsync animations. Designed a user-friendly interface to simplify the lipsync animation process for both experienced and novice animators.
projects.problemStatement: Manual lip-sync animation creation was time-consuming and required significant expertise, limiting accessibility for novice animators and reducing productivity for experienced ones.
projects.solution: Created an automated web-based tool that utilizes audio and text scripts to generate high-quality mouth lipsync animations with green screen background, enabling easy integration into video projects.
keyChallengess: Green screen background precision for video editing workflow

screenshots.alt: Lip-sync animation tool interface showing audio waveform and character mouth positions
screenshots.caption: Automated lip-sync tool interface

metrics.businessImpact: Enabled faster content creation for animation studios

projects.title: Django Paintings Gallery
projects.shortDescription: Full-featured artwork showcase and management platform
projects.detailedDescription: A Django-powered website for artwork showcasing and management. Includes an intuitive user interface for artwork upload, features for easy management and display of artwork on the website, and a seamless experience for artists to upload, manage, and share their artwork with the world.
projects.problemStatement: Artists needed a professional platform to showcase their work online with easy content management capabilities and responsive design for various devices.
projects.solution: Built a comprehensive Django web application with artist portfolio management, image optimization, responsive gallery layouts, and admin interface for content management.

screenshots.alt: Django paintings gallery showing responsive grid layout of artwork
screenshots.caption: Responsive artwork gallery interface

metrics.performanceImprovements: Optimized image loading with 60% faster page load
metrics.scalabilityAchievements: Supports unlimited artwork uploads with pagination

projects.title: OwlSense Defense Analytics Platform
projects.shortDescription: Advanced social media and dark web data extraction system
projects.detailedDescription: Worked on defense OwlSense Project which extracts all data of users from social media to dark web and analyzes user behavior on social media platforms. This comprehensive system processes massive amounts of data for security and intelligence purposes.
projects.problemStatement: Defense organizations needed comprehensive digital intelligence gathering capabilities to analyze user behavior patterns across multiple online platforms including deep web sources.
projects.solution: Developed a scalable microservices architecture using Django, Docker, and Elasticsearch to process, analyze, and store vast amounts of social media and web data with real-time analytics capabilities.
keyChallengess: Processing massive datasets from multiple sources
Real-time data analysis and pattern recognition
Secure data handling and privacy compliance
Scalable architecture for concurrent data processing

screenshots.alt: OwlSense analytics dashboard showing data visualization and user behavior patterns
screenshots.caption: Analytics dashboard with data insights

metrics.scalabilityAchievements: Handles concurrent analysis of 10K+ user profiles
metrics.businessImpact: Enhanced intelligence gathering capabilities for defense sector

projects.title: InstaMunch Restaurant API
projects.shortDescription: Comprehensive restaurant backend system with microservices architecture
projects.detailedDescription: Built robust APIs for InstaMunch restaurant platform and Vodafone car tracking system (VFQ). Implemented microservices architecture using Docker, RabbitMQ, Celery, and scheduled tasks for high-performance backend operations.
projects.problemStatement: Restaurant platforms needed scalable backend systems to handle order management, real-time tracking, and integration with multiple third-party services while maintaining high availability.
projects.solution: Architected and developed microservices-based API system with message queuing, background task processing, and containerized deployment for seamless scaling and maintenance.

screenshots.alt: InstaMunch API documentation showing restaurant management endpoints
screenshots.caption: API documentation and testing interface

metrics.businessImpact: Reduced system downtime by 75% with containerization
